name: Personal Data Protection Law (Royal Decree M/19)
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by Saudi Data and AI Authority (sdaia.gov.sa) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within Saudi Data and AI Authority (sdaia.gov.sa).
